text: welcome to race five of the Apex energy
summer series presented by Boon Chrysler
Dodge Jeep and RAM in this week we'll be
taking on the Taladega Super Speedway
for 60 laps let's hop straight into
qualifying this week you want to roll
out of the pits in fourth gear and set
it around 90 mph until you reach the
blue cone on the backstretch from there
ease onto the throttle and run the
outside until you reach the White Flag
this will ensure that your tires are as
cool as possible for your final
lap exiting the tri elow slowly navigate
from the middle to the inside as you
enter turns one and two keep your
steering as smooth as possible and make
sure you avoid scraping your Splitter on
the apron hold the wheel steady as you
make your way out of the corner and
allow the car to track out to the second
lane keep the car straight as you make
your way down the
backstretch once you reach turns three
and four do it all over again slowly
bring the car down to the yellow line
hold as steady of a wheel as you can and
allow yourself to track out at the
second lane on
exit as soon as you straighten the wheel
on the front stretch keep your eye on
the yellow line in the triel and try to
hit it as smoothly as you can it's easy
to scrub off speed if you turn down too
soon so I would recommend using the
first AED white lines on the inside as a
reference point it may be tempting to
throw it down onto the apron but the
bumps will slow you down if you can hold
a steady wheel and make the most of your
warm-up laps you'll find yourself in a
great position for the
start once the race begins
your best bet would be to get in line
and find drivers to work with if you
already have a team that's great but if
you don't have that luxury I would
recommend finding a group and sticking
with them it's easy to make aggressive
moves with this package so if you can
discipline yourself from the beginning
you'll be more likely to stay out of
trouble just as it was at Daytona the
right rear spoiler will be the weakest
point in traffic the side draft will
bite you if you aren't careful so be
ready for a tug on the wheel if you see
anybody getting close to your quarter
panels if you find yourself being side
DED and pushed at the same time you may
end up crashing so I would recommend
experimenting with the arrow during
practice if you can keep your nose clean
make some friends and keep track of your
fuel mileage you may find yourself in
Victory Lane when it's all said and done
good luck
